an10.89:1.1: athakho kokāliko bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho kokāliko bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an10.89:1.2: pāpicchā bhante sāriputtamoggallānā pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṃgatāti.
an10.89:1.3: mā hevaṃ kokālika mā hevaṃ kokālika
an10.89:2.1: dutiyampi kho kokāliko bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an10.89:2.2: kiñcāpi me bhante bhagavā saddhāyiko paccayiko athakho pāpicchāva sāriputtamoggallānā pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṅgatāti.
an10.89:2.3: mā hevaṃ kokālika mā hevaṃ kokālika
an10.89:3.1: tatiyampi kho kokāliko bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an10.89:3.2: kiñcāpi kho me bhante bhagavā saddhāyiko paccayiko athakho pāpicchāva sāriputtamoggallānā pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṃgatāti.
an10.89:3.3: mā hevaṃ kokālika mā hevaṃ kokālika
an10.89:4.1: athakho kokāliko bhikkhu uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi
an10.89:4.2: acirapakkantassa ca kokālikassa bhikkhuno sāsapamattīhi piḷakāhi sabbo kāyo phuṭṭho ahosi
an10.89:4.3: sāsapamattiyo hutvā muggamattiyo ahesuṃ muggamattiyo hutvā kāḷāyamattiyo ahesuṃ kāḷāyamattiyo hutvā kolaṭṭhimattiyo ahesuṃ kolaṭṭhimattiyo hutvā kolamattiyo ahesuṃ kolamattiyo hutvā āmalakamattiyo ahesuṃ āmalakamattiyo hutvā veluvasalāṭukamattiyo ahesuṃ veluvasalāṭukamattiyo hutvā villamattiyo ahesuṃ villamattiyo hutvā pabhijjiṃsu pubbañca lohitañca pagghariṃsu
an10.89:5.1: athakho tudipaccekabrahmā yena kokāliko bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā vehāse ṭhatvā kokālikaṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca
an10.89:5.6: nanu tvaṃ āvuso bhagavatā anāgāmī byākato atha kiñcarahi idhāgato
an10.89:6.1: athakho tudipaccekabrahmā kokālikaṃ bhikkhuṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi
an10.89:11.2: kālakato ca kokāliko bhikkhu padumanirayaṃ upapajjati sāriputtamoggallānesu cittaṃ āghāṭetvā.
an10.89:12.1: athakho brahmā sahampati abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ jetavanaṃ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho brahmā sahampati bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an10.89:12.3: kālakato ca bhante kokāliko bhikkhu padumanirayaṃ upapanno sāriputtamoggallānesu cittaṃ āghāṭetvāti
an10.89:12.5: idaṃ vatvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatthevantaradhāyi.
an10.89:13.1: athakho bhagavā tassā rattiyā accayena bhikkhū āmantesi
an10.89:13.2: imaṃ bhikkhave rattiṃ brahmā sahampati abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ jetavanaṃ obhāsetvā yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho bhikkhave brahmā sahampati maṃ etadavoca
an10.89:13.4: kālakato ca bhante kokāliko bhikkhu padumanirayaṃ upapanno sāriputtamoggallānesu cittaṃ āghāṭetvāti
an10.89:13.6: idaṃ vatvā maṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatthevantaradhāyīti.
an10.89:14.1: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an10.89:14.2: kīvadīghaṃ nu kho bhante padumaniraye āyuppamāṇanti.
an10.89:14.3: dīghaṃ kho bhikkhu padumaniraye āyuppamāṇaṃ taṃ
an10.89:14.5: ettakāni vassānīti vā ettakāni vassasatānīti vā ettakāni vassasahassānīti vā ettakāni vassasatasahassānīti vāti.
an10.89:15.3: seyyathāpi bhikkhave vīsatikhāriko kosalako tilavāho tato puriso vassasatasahassassa accayena ekamekaṃ tilaṃ uddhareyya
an10.89:15.4: khippataraṃ kho so bhikkhu vīsatikhāriko kosalako tilavāho iminā upakkamena parikkhayaṃ pariyādānaṃ gaccheyya na tveva eko abbudo nirayo
an10.89:15.5: seyyathāpi bhikkhu vīsati abbudā nirayā evameko nirabbudo nirayo
an10.89:15.6: seyyathāpi bhikkhu vīsati nirabbudā nirayā evameko ababbo nirayo
an10.89:15.7: seyyathāpi bhikkhu vīsati ababbā nirayā evameko ahaho nirayo seyyathāpi bhikkhu vīsati ahahā nirayā evameko aṭaṭo nirayo
an10.89:15.8: seyyathāpi bhikkhu vīsati aṭaṭā nirayā evameko
an10.89:15.10: seyyathāpi bhikkhu vīsati kumudā nirayā evameko sogandhiko nirayo
an10.89:15.11: seyyathāpi bhikkhu vīsati sogandhikā nirayā evameko uppalo nirayo
an10.89:15.12: seyyathāpi bhikkhu uppalā nirayā evameko puṇḍarīko nirayo
an10.89:15.13: seyyathāpi bhikkhu vīsati puṇḍarīkā nirayā evameko padumo nirayo
an10.89:15.14: padumaṃ kho pana bhikkhu nirayaṃ kokāliko bhikkhu upapanno sāriputtamoggallānesu cittaṃ āghāṭetvāti
an10.89:15.16: idaṃ vatvāna sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā
